edits.original: Field crews still collect vouchers, make no mistake.
edits.reason: The phrase "make no mistake" is a redundant trailer equivalent to the rule's "not X" clauses: it adds nothing to the ordinary-knowledge point that field crews collect vouchers.

edits.original: Herbarium staff still mark sterile Carex sheets as undetermined… until a fruiting collection arrives.
edits.replacement: Herbarium staff still mark sterile Carex sheets as undetermined until a fruiting collection arrives.
edits.reason: The ellipsis-plus-space "… until" tacked onto the clause reads as a bolted-on trailer; tightening it to a single flowing clause removes the pause without changing meaning.

edits.original: A robust regression of leaf mass on area down-weights herbivore-damaged outliers in allometric studies.
edits.replacement: In allometric studies, a robust regression of leaf mass on area down-weights herbivore-damaged outliers.
edits.reason: The trailing prepositional phrase "in allometric studies" is a checkable qualifier smuggled into a bolted-on tail; fronting it gives the distinction its proper place in the sentence.

edits.original: so the change significantly streamlines cell-wall composition analysis
edits.replacement: so the change streamlines cell-wall composition analysis
edits.reason: The adverb "significantly" is a redundant intensifier trailer after the stated 40-to-6-minute drop, which already shows the magnitude.

edits.original: Rubisco is the only carboxylase in the Calvin-Benson cycle, full stop.
edits.replacement: Rubisco is the only carboxylase in the Calvin-Benson cycle.
edits.reason: "Full stop" is an emphatic trailer equivalent to the rule's "not X" clauses; the claim stands on its own and the assertion is verifiable from standard biochemistry texts.

edits.original: close to the C4-versus-CAM split, spatial packing is the C4 case, temporal packing is the CAM one.
edits.replacement: a division that parallels the C4-versus-CAM distinction between spatial and temporal carbon concentration.
edits.reason: The comma-spliced trailer restates the preceding two regimes in clipped fragments ("the C4 case... the CAM one"), so folding it into the sentence removes the bolted-on repetition while preserving the same content.

edits.original: The seedlings bolted in week 3 they never formed heads—the market rejected the entire lot.
edits.replacement: The seedlings bolted in week 3 and never formed heads, so the market rejected the entire lot.
edits.reason: The run-on trailer "they never formed heads" duplicates the bolting claim and hangs off the sentence without a connector; joining the clauses makes the consequence explicit rather than tacked on.

edits.original: Conservation collections still accession landraces, rather than heirlooms.
edits.reason: Uncertain under the ordinary-knowledge test: "heirlooms" is arguably the natural counterpart of "landraces," but the terms overlap in horticultural usage, so I cannot tell whether this trailer is a redundant antonym to cut or a genuine distinction needing its own sentence.

edits.original: Breeders select dwarfing alleles on purpose, rather than by accident.
edits.replacement: Breeders select dwarfing alleles on purpose.
edits.reason: "By accident" is the ordinary, general-knowledge antonym of "on purpose," so the trailer adds nothing and should be cut.

edits.original: Yield loss fell from 41 percent in rainfed plots to 8 percent with irrigation, so supplemental irrigation dramatically reduces yield loss in dry years.
edits.replacement: Yield loss fell from 41 percent in rainfed plots to 8 percent with irrigation, so supplemental irrigation reduces yield loss in dry years.
edits.reason: The intensifier "dramatically" is a redundant trailer; the 41-to-8-percent figures already convey the size of the reduction.

edits.original: Morphine is not synthesized by the Pacific yew; it is produced in Papaver somniferum latex.
edits.replacement: Morphine is produced in *Papaver somniferum* latex.
edits.reason: The negative clause merely denies what the preceding sentence already established (morphine from *Papaver somniferum*, paclitaxel from the Pacific yew), so it is a redundant "not X" statement that can be cut.

edits.original: The construct was designed for chloroplast transformation, not nuclear transformation.
edits.replacement: The construct targets the chloroplast genome rather than the nuclear one.
edits.reason: Rewritten as a single positive statement of what the construct does instead of a claim plus a bolted-on "not X" denial.
